name: RC-B10-0216/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the new Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises a new Chinese law on "ethnic unity and progress", adopted in March 2026. It says the law forces minority groups, including Tibetans, Uyghurs and Mongolians, to assimilate and restricts their language, culture and religion. The Parliament asks China to repeal the law. It also asks European Union countries to use the EU human rights sanctions regime against officials responsible, and to suspend extradition treaties with China. The text is an opinion and a set of requests; it does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks China to repeal the law and asks EU countries to act.
- **Who it affects:** Chinese officials facing possible EU sanctions, and people in the EU at risk of Chinese prosecution.
- **What happens next:** EU governments decide on sanctions and extradition treaties; the Parliament has no power to do this alone.
